coordinates.notes: Published mesh positions are preserved without per-structure centering or scaling. Units and anatomical axes have not been verified. This file is one surface mesh; it is not segmented into individual bones. These are researcher-processed cranial and mandibular surfaces; their alignment has not yet been visually verified. The authors explicitly state Gavialis meshes are scaled to skull length, not original size.
